title: Sophia Fullbrook named Second Team All-American by Golfweek
text:
Florida State University women’s golf sophomore Sophia Fullbrook was named a Second Team All-American by Golfweek on June 10. The announcement follows her performance at the NCAA Championship, where she finished 20th overall with an even-par score of 288.
Fullbrook also received Second Team All-American honors from the Women’s Golf Coaches Association. During the season, she participated in 12 tournaments, securing first place or tying for the win in three events and finishing within the top ten seven times. Her season scoring average was 71.16, which ties for the eighth-best average in program history. She concluded the season ranked 18th by Scoreboard and is listed as number 38 in the World Golf Amateur Rankings.
Prior to her NCAA Championship appearance, Fullbrook was recognized as an All-Atlantic Coast Conference selection and earned ACC co-Golfer of the Month honors for March.
Fullbrook’s recognition marks the 27th time a Florida State player has earned an All-America honor from Golfweek since 2006.
She has also been selected to compete as part of The R&A’s Curtis Cup team, with matches scheduled to take place June 12-14 at Bel-Air Country Club.
